title: scientific_revision whose predecessor is a different par_id (lineage to a foreign record)
note: No check that predecessor shares par_id or origin_assertion_identifier; identity continuity unenforced.

title: version '0' claims predecessor version '1' of same par_id (lineage runs backward)
note: par_version is an unordered string; no monotonicity or acyclicity check.

title: representation_correction changes the measured value (meaning change disguised as representation fix)
note: Validator cannot see predecessor content; revision_kind is a self-declaration with no diff check.

title: composition whose only evidence is a verbatim copy of its input's instrument evidence, inherited_evidence=false
note: Evidence inheritance by copy is undetectable; the const-false flag is vacuous.

title: composition cites activity_id 'analysis-7' that appears in no provenance.activities entry
note: Dangling activity reference accepted; the derivation is untraceable despite 'traceable evidence'.

title: composition declares result.state=observed with only computational_inference evidence and an instrument origin copied from the input
note: observed vs inferred is not cross-checked against evidence.basis or derivation.kind.

title: not_derivable outcome attached to basis=experimental_measurement, source.kind=instrument_record (fixture as shipped)
note: A failed derivation is attributed to an instrument trace, not to an analysis artifact; outcome/basis/source.kind not cross-checked.

title: evidence direction=supports with outcome=failed
note: A failed procedure cannot support a measured value; no direction/outcome coherence rule.

title: null_result fixture as shipped: epistemic_status=observed, polarity=affirmative, result.state=not_observed
note: Record asserts an affirmative observed claim about a quantity that was not observed.

title: two evidence items, identical source identifier+locator, second self-declared assessed_independent
note: Independence is a free self-declaration; identical locators not detected even within one record.

title: released record whose sole evidence locator is 'x' and identifier scheme/value are '?'
note: Traceability threshold is minLength=1; any non-empty string is a 'precise locator'.

title: retrieved_at='yesterday, probably' with format:date-time
note: FormatChecker without rfc3339-validator silently skips date-time; passes in the shipped environment spec.

title: record_status=released with verification.status=failed
note: Release gate ignores a recorded failed source check.

title: withdrawn record with no successors and no reason slot
note: OBSERVED: withdrawal carries no reason/field; a retracted claim is indistinguishable from a superseded one.

title: observed value NaN (Python json accepts; JSON does not)
note: jsonschema 'number' admits NaN; interval checks with NaN compare False.

title: CI with lower=NaN
note: lower>upper is False for NaN; semantic check bypassed.

title: point value 4.12 outside its own 95% CI [10,20]
note: No value-within-interval check.

title: uncertainty kind=exact carrying upper, level and parameters
note: The not-anyOf guard forbids value/lower/distribution only; upper/level/parameters leak through.

title: standard_error = 0 on a physical measurement (exact disguised as SE)
note: Non-negativity check admits zero spread; no distinction from kind=exact.

title: decay-rate reported in 'furlongs per fortnight per kelvin'
note: Unit is an opaque identifier; dimensional consistency with quantity is not representable, so not checkable.

title: censored result with detection limit only in prose, no numeric bound slot
note: OBSERVED: schema has no numeric censoring bound; limit of detection is unrecoverable by machine.

title: quantitative proposition with polarity=negative ('decay-rate is NOT 4.12 +/- 0.15'?)
note: OBSERVED: negation of a measurement has undefined semantics but is accepted.

title: aggregation_level=population from unit_of_observation='one instrument run' (ecological inflation)
note: Single aggregation_level field; no observed-vs-claimed aggregation, so the ecological guard cannot be expressed.

title: projection basis = 'because'
note: Basis presence only (acknowledged in KNOWN_GAPS 9).

title: projection kind=transport while observed_system == claimed_system
note: Projection declared where none occurred; no contradiction flagged.

title: process with one step and zero transitions
note: A 'process' with no ordering or transition is accepted; transitions minItems=0.

title: process transition step-a precedes step-a (self-loop) and step-b unreachable
note: No acyclicity/reachability; endpoints exist so check passes.

title: proposition.type=conjecture, epistemic_status=observed, released with supporting positive evidence
note: Type-level 'conjecture' and status-level 'observed' coexist; the two encodings of epistemic stance are unreconciled.

title: conjecture_draft as shipped: provenance.origin is instrument-run-17 (a hypothesis 'originating' from an instrument trace)
note: origin.kind enum has no slot for an asserted/authored proposition; provenance forces a source_locator on an idea.

title: record declaring a profile and carrying one profile-specific field at root
errors: root: Additional properties are not allowed ('profile_data' was unexpected)
note: EXPECT REJECT by additionalProperties=false: profiles cannot add any field anywhere; extensibility claim is unimplementable.

title: profile field inside proposition
errors: proposition: {'type': 'quantitative', 'quantity': {'scheme': 'local', 'value': 'decay-rate'}, 'result': {'state': 'observed', 'value': 4.12, 'unit': {'scheme': 'unit', 'value': 's^-1'}, 'uncertainty': {'kind': 'standard_error', 'value': 0.15}}, 'estimand': 'mean rate in apparatus 4', 'parameter': {'scheme': 'local', 'value': 'model-parameter-k'}, 'profile_ext': {'x': 1}} is not valid under any of the given schemas
note: Same: additionalProperties=false on every object.

title: fixtures sharing one origin_assertion_identifier
note: {"{\"scheme\": \"laboratory-local\", \"value\": \"original-observation-17\"}": ["physical_measurement", "measured_zero", "failed_observation_draft", "two_distributions_single_origin", "contradictory_released", "conjecture_draft", "null_result", "not_derivable_draft", "process", "scope_projection_draft", "relational_unevidenced_draft", "composed_with_own_evidence"]}

title: same evidence_id+locator used across fixtures with differing direction/outcome
note: {"ev-physical-001@run-17/trace-A/measurement-1": [["physical_measurement", "supports", "positive"], ["measured_zero", "supports", "measured_zero"], ["failed_observation_draft", "inconclusive", "failed"], ["two_distributions_single_origin", "supports", "positive"], ["contradictory_released", "contradicts", "negative"], ["null_result", "inconclusive", "null_result"], ["not_derivable_draft", "inconclusive", "not_derivable"], ["process", "supports", "positive"]]}

title: tests that do not exercise the validator
note: test_22 and test_38 assert fixture-file contents only; test_40 (json.loads(json.dumps(r))==r) is true for any JSON; test_39 asserts rights=unknown passes release gate, codifying the acknowledged gap as expected behaviour; test_14 asserts validity only, not that two distributions resolve to one origin.
